test_title: SSC CGL 2024 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 12 Sept, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: In which year was the Digital India mission launched?
solution:
The correct answer is __**2015**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Digital India mission was launched by the Government of India on **1st July 2015**.
 
• It aims to ensure that Government services are made available to citizens electronically by improving online infrastructure and by increasing Internet connectivity or by making the country digitally empowered in the field of technology.
 
• The initiative includes plans to connect rural areas with high-speed internet networks.
 
• Digital India consists of three core components: the development of secure and stable digital infrastructure, delivering government services digitally, and universal digital literacy.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Digital Infrastructure**

 
 
• One of the primary objectives of the Digital India initiative is to create a robust digital infrastructure that ensures high-speed internet connectivity across the country.
 
• It involves laying optical fiber cables, promoting mobile connectivity, and establishing Wi-Fi hotspots in rural and urban areas.
 
• This initiative also includes the establishment of common service centers (CSCs) that provide digital access points for various government services.
 
 
 
• **Governance and Services on Demand**
 
 
• Digital India aims to transform the way government services are delivered to citizens by making them available online.
 
• This includes services such as online filing of taxes, applying for government schemes, accessing educational resources, and availing healthcare services.
 
• The initiative promotes the use of e-governance to enhance transparency and efficiency in the delivery of public services.
 
 
 
• **Digital Literacy**
 
 
• Ensuring digital literacy for all citizens is a key component of the Digital India mission.
 
• The initiative focuses on providing digital education and training to individuals, especially in rural areas, to empower them with the skills needed to navigate the digital world.
 
• Various programs and campaigns are conducted to promote digital literacy and bridge the digital divide.
